title: TechNova interview schedule released
message: The technical interview schedule for shortlisted TechNova candidates has been published.
body: The technical interview schedule for shortlisted TechNova candidates has been published. Students listed in the attached schedule should report to the T&P Cell 20 minutes before their assigned slot with a printed resume and college ID. After checking the schedule, update your personal Application Tracker with your interview time and preparation notes.

title: Resume review desk
message: Students can visit the T&P office between 2:00 PM and 4:00 PM for resume feedback.
body: The resume review desk will be open in the T&P office between 2:00 PM and 4:00 PM. Bring a digital or printed copy of your latest resume. Reviews will be handled on a first-come, first-served basis.

title: Aptitude practice resources
message: A new set of aptitude practice questions has been shared with all final-year students.
body: A curated aptitude practice pack covering quantitative ability, logical reasoning, and verbal ability is now available. Students preparing for upcoming online assessments should complete the timed sections before the weekend.

title: DataNest pre-placement briefing
message: The briefing recording and role overview are available for students who could not attend.
body: Students who missed the DataNest pre-placement briefing can review the role overview and key eligibility notes. Please read the material before the application deadline and use the Opportunities page to confirm your eligibility.

title: Placement policy reminder
message: Review the updated placement participation guidelines before applying to upcoming drives.
body: The placement participation guidelines have been updated. Students should review attendance expectations, offer acceptance rules, and document requirements before applying to upcoming drives.
